experiments.name: Coordinate/export invariants and gold reconciliation
inputs: Lawful blank forms and owned exact-gold geometric fixtures
CropBox/MediaBox offsets, userUnit, 0/90/180/270 PDF rotations, zoom/DPR
Crop, deskew, perspective, above-label, far-margin, mixed native/raster
metrics: export-render anchor displacement in PDF points
proposed_go: All enumerated invariant fixtures pass agreed numeric tolerance
Export-render anchors within1 PDF point, zero wrong-page/rotation
Reconcile earlier32 vs current34 positives with annotation changelog before comparative precision/recall
stop: Relabeling correct values as correct placements without target overlap

experiments.name: Assisted completion and missing-field recovery
design: Paired counterbalanced matched tasks on lawful template-disjoint blanks
First-use and repeat tasks; mouse, keyboard, actual touch devices
proposed_go: At least25% lower paired median completion time
Completion rate not lower; residual wrong fills not higher
Every missed field manually recoverable; undo and skip available
stop: Time gain trades for missed/wrong fields
Correct source text but wrong placement counted successful

experiments.name: Private reviewed template maps and fail-closed registration
phases: Manual corner registration or verified anchor alignment only after exact-map validation
proposed_go: Repeat tasks faster including declared amortized setup
At least50% fewer placement actions on repeats
All seeded revision/page/role drift traps rejected
No previous-person values persisted in blank map or carried over
stop: Template identity or homography used to bypass person/source authority

experiments.name: Optional tiny blank-field detector
experiments.baseline: Current spatial field candidates; same source-value/person/review layers
experiments.runtime: Proposed fp32 ORT Web WASM; exact graph not validated
prerequisites: Checkpoint/code notices and training provenance limitations recorded
Full cold-network and actual phone resource measurements; ceilings preregistered from target devices
proposed_go: At least+10 percentage-point target-field recall at precision>=.95 on frozen family-disjoint scans
Placement/export and human-time benefits also pass
stop: Unsupported operators or no material layout/time gain
Cost judged only from model file size
Vendor benchmark treated as app release evidence
